update-9-0-0-replace-set-parser-options-.description: Replaces the removed `setParserOptionsProject` application generator option with `enableTypedLinting` in generator defaults

update-9-0-1-add-webpack-library-type.description: Sets `output.library` to `commonjs2` in Forge app Webpack configs so the bundled functions export their handlers

update-10-0-0-bundle-dependencies.description: Makes the build of each Forge app inline all dependencies and write to the `functions` folder of the artifact directory instead of `src`

update-10-0-0-add-app-packaging-configur.description: Adds the app packaging configuration for manual Forge packaging to the manifest of each Forge app

update-10-0-0-remove-package-ts-config.description: Removes the dropped `tsConfig` option from Forge app package targets

update-10-0-0-remove-ui-kit-packaging-op.description: Removes the dropped `uiKit2Packaging` option from Forge app package targets, now that UI Kit resources are always packaged so that Forge can load them

update-10-0-0-move-resource-paths.description: Moves the paths of Forge manifest resources in the old `src` folder of the artifact directory to the `functions` folder
